zh: 下班顺路接孩子放学。
old_en: I picked up the kids on my way home from work.
new_en: I pick up the kids on my way home from work.

zh: 下班后我顺路去接孩子。
old_en: After work, I picked up the kids on my way home.
new_en: After work, I pick up the kids on my way home.

zh: 今天朋友从机场接我。
old_en: My friend picked me up from the airport.
new_en: Today, a friend picked me up from the airport.

zh: 我去驿站把快递取回来。
old_en: I went to the post office to pick up my parcel.
new_en: I went to the post office to pick up my package.

zh: 我去餐厅取了外卖，顺便给儿子也拿了一份。
old_en: I picked up my takeout at the restaurant and got some for my son too.
new_en: I picked up my takeout and got some for my son too.

zh: 外卖到了，我下楼取一下。
old_en: I went downstairs to pick up the takeout.
new_en: The takeout is here, I'll go downstairs to get it.

zh: 我把垃圾拿到楼下扔掉。
old_en: I carried the trash downstairs to drop it off.
new_en: I take the trash downstairs to throw it away.

zh: 我每天早上都会送孩子去学校。
old_en: I usually drop my kid off at school every morning.
new_en: I drop my kid off at school every morning.

zh: 今天下雨，我让爸爸送孩子去学校。
old_en: Since it's raining today, I asked my dad to pick up my kid from school.
new_en: It's raining today, so I asked my dad to take my kid to school.

zh: 让司机在门口接你下班。
old_en: Let the driver pick you up at the door when you're leaving work.
new_en: Let the driver pick you up at the door when you finish work.

zh: 我让司机在公司门口接我。
old_en: I had the driver pick me up at the company entrance.
new_en: I asked the driver to pick me up at the company gate.

zh: 我去火车站帮朋友取行李。
old_en: I went to the station to pick up my friend's luggage.
new_en: I went to the train station to pick up my friend's luggage.

zh: 朋友让我去机场帮她拿行李。
old_en: My friend asked me to go to the airport and pick up her luggage.
new_en: My friend asked me to go to the airport and pick up her luggage.

zh: 我下班顺路接了孩子，顺便买了一些水果。
old_en: On my way home from work, I picked up my child and bought some fruit.
new_en: On my way home from work, I picked up my child and bought some fruit.

zh: 昨天我下班顺路接了妹妹，带她去吃晚饭。
old_en: I picked up my sister on my way home from work yesterday and took her out for dinner.
new_en: Yesterday, I picked up my sister on my way home and took her out for dinner.

zh: 我开车送同事回家。
old_en: I dropped off my colleague at home by car.
new_en: I drove my colleague home.

zh: 我把旧纸箱拿到楼下回收。
old_en: I dropped off the old cardboard boxes in the basement.
new_en: I took the old cardboard boxes downstairs for recycling.

zh: 我把公文包放到前台寄存处。
old_en: I dropped off my briefcase at the front desk.
new_en: I left my briefcase at the front desk.

zh: 她让服务员把行李送到前台。
old_en: She asked the waiter to drop off her luggage at the front desk.
new_en: She asked the staff to bring her luggage to the front desk.

zh: 我开车去接同事下班。
old_en: I picked up my colleague from work.
new_en: I drove to pick up my coworker after work.
